scope: Read-only verification that the existing production Twilio Auth Token is retrievable outside the API server; no token creation, rotation, production edit, provider API action, deployment or paid operation

productionSource.metadata: root-owned 0600; one TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN and one TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID assignment with expected formats; source predates the running PM2 API process

independentRetrieval.source: Twilio Console Account Info for the account selected by the deployed Account SID suffix; owner copied the current primary Auth Token
independentRetrieval.comparison: A temporary owner-side helper compared the Console clipboard with a fresh read of the deployed source using constant-time exact comparison; pass/fail only was printed and the clipboard was cleared

custodyDecision: Twilio Console can reveal the matching existing primary token outside the API server. No additional Apple Passwords copy was created for this check; provider-account access remains a dependency. No credential value, hash or account SID was committed.
